title: Welcome to Updates & Notices
body:
This is where we'll share announcements, new features, and important notices about FreeTV Garden — so you always know what's changed.

**Stay connected with us:**

- 📢 Join our [Telegram channel](https://t.me/Freetools_channel) for the latest updates and information, straight from us.
- 💬 Join our [Telegram discussion group](https://t.me/aFreetools) to interact with other users, ask questions, and share tips.
- ✉️ Report issues or share suggestions directly at **contact.freetool@gmail.com**, or through the Feedback option on [freetvgarden.com](https://freetvgarden.com).

We read every message and update this panel whenever there's something worth telling you about — thanks for being here!

title: 🎧 Play TV & Radio in the Background
body: You can now keep any TV channel or radio playing in the background on FreeTV Garden, just like a music app. Continue listening while using other apps, browsing other tabs, or with your screen turned off. 📱🎶 For background playback to work properly, make sure **battery and background data usage are enabled for your browser on your device**.

title: 🌐 FreeTV Garden Now Available in 74 Languages
body: FreeTV Garden is now available in 74 languages! You can use the website in your native language, with translated menus, navigation, and page content. Simply open Select Language and choose your preferred language.

title: Important: Check Channel Availability
body:
TV channel availability can change at any time. Some channels may be temporarily unavailable because their original stream is offline, has changed, or is experiencing a technical issue.

**⚠️ An “Offline” label does not always mean the channel is unavailable.** Some channels may still be working even when they are initially marked Offline.

**If you see a channel marked Offline, click and try playing it.** If the stream starts playing successfully, the channel status will be **updated automatically in real time** to show that the channel is working.

**🌍 Availability may also vary by region.** Some channels or streams may be restricted in certain countries or regions due to **geo-restrictions**, while the same channel may work normally for viewers in other regions.

If a channel does not play, it may be temporarily unavailable or restricted in your region. Please try again later or check whether the channel is available from another region.

If you find a channel that is playing but still incorrectly marked Offline, please report it to [contact.freetool@gmail.com](mailto:contact.freetool@gmail.com).
